304 N. 8th Street, Ste 325 ● PO Box 83720 ● Boise, Idaho 83720-0032 phone (208) 334-3900 ● fax (208) 334-2438 ● http://dfm.idaho.gov/ September 17, 2025 MEMORANDUM To: Agency Directors Fiscal Officers From: Lori Wolff, Administrator Subject: FY 2026 Budget Update I want to start by thanking all agencies for their timely submission of their FY 26 and FY 27 budget submissions. Governor Little appreciates your focus on implementing the 3% holdback for FY 26 expenditures and your cooperation in submitting maintenance-only budgets for FY 2027. As we prepare for the FY 2027 Executive Budget submission, we must continue to balance our state’s strong economic position with the responsibility of keeping government right-sized and sustainable. While revenues remain healthy, they are trending lower than prior forecasts. To that end, we are asking all executive agencies, with the exception of public schools, to revise their FY 2027 budget requests to reflect an ongoing 3% reduction in general fund expenditures. This 3% reduction aligns with the holdbacks requested in FY 2026 and ensures ongoing spending aligns with estimated revenue forecasts. In keeping with the spirit of Governor Little’s Executive Order 2025-05, “The Idaho Act,” these reductions should focus on efficiencies, restructuring, and prioritization of core services. We encourage agencies to: • Identify opportunities to streamline operations and eliminate lower-priority activities. • Protect essential services that directly impact Idaho citizens. • Leverage technology and innovation to improve service delivery at lower cost. We are also asking all executive agencies to take a one-year pause on all general fund replacement items and zero out replacement general fund requests in your FY 2027 budget revision. This effort is about ensuring that Idaho government remains lean, efficient, and aligned with the values of our taxpayers. By right-sizing government today, we strengthen our ability to fund the state’s highest priorities well into the future and create an even stronger economy. Please make sure you are sharing your revision plans with your Governor’s office liaison and your DFM analyst prior to submission.

# Page 2^page=2
Budget Actions: We appreciate your support in making these revisions as quickly as possible. Governor Little wants agencies in the driver’s seat to determine the best areas within your agencies to make these reductions, which is why he is asking agencies to make these revisions now, so they can be considered as we prepare the Governor’s Executive Budget. We are asking that all budget revisions be submitted by October 3rd, 2025. We realize this is a very tight turnaround, so please work with your DFM budget analyst to make the revisions for FY 2027 as quickly as possible. Please make your ongoing General Fund holdbacks reflect the amounts in the attachment to the August 19 memo. Enter this as a 12.75 using the 5100 form. Ensure that when calculating amounts for any positions involved in this action, you include the fully loaded cost of the position and include health insurance costs. Further technical guidance will be forthcoming.  In addition to the ongoing 3% reductions to your FY2027 budget request, you must zero out your general fund replacement items. Thank you for your continued leadership and commitment to responsible stewardship of taxpayer resources. Working together, we can ensure that Idaho remains one of the best-managed states in the nation.
